1\. condition hardcodes operator spacing 📘 Rule violation ⚙ Maintainability 
WrapperEmitter constructs generated conditions with embedded spaces around || and == instead
of SourceWriter spacing/operator helpers. This violates the required formatting abstraction for
generated source.
Agent Prompt ``` ## Issue description Generated empty-array conditions hardcode spaces around `||` and `==`. ## Issue Context PR Compliance 2845364 requires generated-code formatting to use `SourceWriter` helpers rather than embedding operator spacing in string literals. ## Fix Focus Areas - src/Compiler/Kassyi.GSharp.Compiler/WrapperEmitter.cs[57-58] ``` ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools

2\. Marshaling conditions hardcode spacing 📘 Rule violation ⚙ Maintainability 
New generated if conditions embed spaces around comparison and logical operators directly in
source literals. They must use SourceWriter token and spacing helpers instead.
Agent Prompt ``` ## Issue description The new marshaling guards hardcode formatting spaces around `>`, `&&`, and `!=` in generated source. ## Issue Context PR Compliance 2845364 requires operator spacing in generated code to come from `SourceWriter` helpers. ## Fix Focus Areas - src/Compiler/Kassyi.GSharp.Compiler/MarshalingEmitter.cs[101-101] - src/Compiler/Kassyi.GSharp.Compiler/MarshalingEmitter.cs[155-155] - src/Compiler/Kassyi.GSharp.Compiler/MarshalingEmitter.cs[305-305] - src/Compiler/Kassyi.GSharp.Compiler/MarshalingEmitter.cs[466-466] ``` ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools

3\. Wrapper emits raw parentheses 📘 Rule violation ⚙ Maintainability 
The new generated if statement writes its parentheses directly through AppendLine rather than
writer.Parentheses(). This bypasses the mandatory delimiter scope helper.
Agent Prompt ``` ## Issue description The generated empty-array `if` statement emits raw parentheses. ## Issue Context PR Compliance 2845360 requires generated parentheses to be emitted via `SourceWriter.Parentheses()` using the `using` pattern. ## Fix Focus Areas - src/Compiler/Kassyi.GSharp.Compiler/WrapperEmitter.cs[58-58] ``` ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools

4\. Marshaling emits raw delimiters 📘 Rule violation ⚙ Maintainability 
The new marshaling guards and compact finally statements emit parentheses and braces as raw string
characters. All such generated delimiters must use Parentheses() and Scope() helpers.
Agent Prompt ``` ## Issue description New marshaling output writes condition parentheses and `finally` braces directly in string literals. ## Issue Context PR Compliance 2845360 requires `SourceWriter.Parentheses()` and `SourceWriter.Scope()` for all generated delimiters. ## Fix Focus Areas - src/Compiler/Kassyi.GSharp.Compiler/MarshalingEmitter.cs[101-101] - src/Compiler/Kassyi.GSharp.Compiler/MarshalingEmitter.cs[116-116] - src/Compiler/Kassyi.GSharp.Compiler/MarshalingEmitter.cs[155-155] - src/Compiler/Kassyi.GSharp.Compiler/MarshalingEmitter.cs[167-167] ``` ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools

5\. Empty arrays suppress outputs 🐞 Bug ≡ Correctness 
The generated host wrapper returns before launch whenever any direct array is empty, so kernels
cannot perform valid zero-item behavior or assign independent ref/out results. ProcessPhysics
demonstrates this: with zero particles it still assigns successFlag = false, but the new return
prevents that assignment and the subsequent output copy-back path.
Agent Prompt ``` ## Issue description Generated host launch methods return whenever any direct array parameter is empty, suppressing valid kernel behavior and ref/out output production. ## Issue Context The marshaling emitter now independently avoids zero-byte CUDA allocation and copy calls. A null device pointer can still be passed for an empty array to a kernel whose count guard makes that pointer unused, allowing independent scalar/output logic to execute. ## Fix Focus Areas - src/Compiler/Kassyi.GSharp.Compiler/WrapperEmitter.cs[52-66] - src/Compiler/Kassyi.GSharp.Compiler/MarshalingEmitter.cs[302-329] - tests/Kassyi.GSharp.Tests/TestCases/GEN-06_ComprehensiveSpecKernel.cu.cs[77-86] ``` ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools
